reason: Verified. The round-3 no-control decision is gated on `listed` (data-past="listed" or print) — the record room and paper. The owner gets the folded form: driven, owner-flight and owner-editing render data-past="folded", a details disclosure, 3 .b-behindRow, and zero focusable elements inside .b-behind even when opened, while the measure beside it carries 7 Edit grabs. So the decision that covers guests does not cover the owner's copy, and a moment is uneditable the day after it passes.
sharpenedFix: The fix is right to reuse the row control but wrong that the editor already takes a past date: commitDate refuses away<1 ("That day has gone") and setAway clamps to Math.max(1,...). So: render owner past rows through the existing row() with owner=true (backMeasure already draws them, passing false), giving the same .b-grab and openEditor; then widen the floor so a moment already behind may sit at a negative away down to the project's first day, keeping "tomorrow is the soonest" only for moments still ahead. Gate on o.owner, never on listed. Assert re-dating forward returns it to the measure.
